The c836d8a P1 (a greedy pane starving a neighbour's picture out of window.snapshot and session.snapshot while pane.snapshot still drew it, order-dependently) is closed by scoping the decode budget per pane. Verified by re-running the original dose-response attack in both pane orders on all three snapshot paths; by a discriminating five-distinct-colour scene proving the budget still refuses and truncates at the SAME placement on both paths; by ten pixel metrics at exact 0/0 covering truncation, both orders, zoom, resize and the session path; by a negative control on a self-built pre-fix binary that makes the same comparator fail with 17100 changed pixels; and by mutation M17, which reverts the scoping and produces the test's stated failure message.
